senses.en: An electronic message, or the system used to send it
Send someone a message using email

ex.en: Please email me the photos from our camping trip.
Although email enables rapid communication, excessive messages can distract employees and reduce productivity at work.

tip: Khi chỉ một lá thư thì đếm được; khi chỉ phương thức liên lạc thì không đếm được, ví dụ by email.

senses.zh: bài kiểm tra; sự thử nghiệm; sự kiểm tra
senses.en: a procedure that checks knowledge, ability, condition, or performance

senses.zh: kiểm tra; thử nghiệm; xét nghiệm
senses.en: to check what someone knows or how something performs

ex.en: I have a spelling test at school tomorrow.
Researchers must test new materials under different conditions before recommending their use in public buildings.

col: take a test｜làm bài kiểm tra
test a theory｜kiểm chứng một lý thuyết
tip: Dùng take a test để nói làm bài kiểm tra; dùng pass a test để nói vượt qua bài kiểm tra.

senses.en: The seventh month of the year, following June

ex.en: We usually visit our cousins for a week in July.
In many northern countries, tourism peaks in July, creating seasonal jobs but increasing pressure on local services.

col: by the end of July｜trước cuối tháng Bảy
tip: Tên tháng luôn viết hoa chữ cái đầu; dùng in July để nói vào tháng Bảy.

senses.en: The number representing no quantity.
The point marked as nothing on a measuring scale.

ex.en: The temperature fell below zero while we were sleeping.
Achieving zero carbon emissions will require substantial investment in renewable energy, public transport, and more efficient buildings.

tip: Khi đọc số điện thoại, zero cũng thường được đọc là oh; với nhiệt độ thì dùng zero.

senses.en: One more time, or on another occasion.

ex.en: Could you say that again a little more slowly?
If cities fail to address the causes of congestion, the same transport problems will occur again.

col: again and again｜lặp đi lặp lại
tip: again diễn tả sự lặp lại; again and again nhấn mạnh việc lặp lại nhiều lần.

senses.en: used to greet someone or begin a phone conversation
a greeting spoken when meeting someone

ex.en: Hello, would you like to sit next to me?
A simple hello between neighbours can encourage social contact and help newcomers feel welcome in a community.

col: a friendly hello｜lời chào thân thiện
tip: hello mở đầu cuộc gọi điện thoại tương đương “alô”; say hello to nghĩa là gửi lời chào đến ai.

senses.en: Human beings considered together or referred to in general.
A group sharing a culture, history, or national identity.

ex.en: Several people were waiting outside the bakery this morning.
Cities should provide accessible public transport so that people of all ages can travel independently.

col: indigenous peoples｜các dân tộc bản địa
people from all walks of life｜mọi tầng lớp trong xã hội
tip: Dùng people với nghĩa “mọi người”; peoples chỉ nhiều dân tộc.

senses.en: a country in North America, north of the United States

ex.en: My cousin moved to Canada to study environmental science.
Canada attracts international students through its universities, although living costs vary considerably between cities.

tip: Tên quốc gia viết hoa chữ cái đầu, thường không có the đứng trước.

senses.en: A primate that usually has a tail and climbs trees.

ex.en: A little monkey swung between branches above our heads.
Protecting tropical forests helps preserve monkey populations and the complex ecosystems on which they depend.

col: a troop of monkeys｜một đàn khỉ
monkey around｜nghịch ngợm; làm trò khỉ
tip: monkey thường có đuôi; ape chỉ loài vượn, thường không có đuôi.

senses.en: to rest with your weight supported by your bottom
to be in a particular place or position

senses.zh: dự thi; tham gia kỳ thi
senses.en: to take an examination

ex.en: Come and sit beside me on the garden bench.
Students who sit for long periods should take regular breaks to support their physical health.

tip: Quá khứ và quá khứ phân từ đều là sat; hiện tại phân từ là sitting.

senses.en: A place or object for someone to sit on.

senses.zh: cho ngồi; có đủ chỗ cho (bao nhiêu người)
senses.en: To provide a sitting place or have room for seated people.

senses.zh: ghế (trong cơ quan dân cử); nghị trường
senses.en: A position as a member of an elected body.

ex.en: She saved me a seat near the front.
Providing more seats on public transport would make daily travel easier for older passengers and families.

col: a window seat｜ghế cạnh cửa sổ
win a seat｜giành được một ghế (trong quốc hội)
tip: sit là nội động từ; seat thường theo sau là người, be seated nghĩa là ngồi xuống.

senses.zh: cái tách; cái cốc; một tách
senses.en: A small drinking container, or the amount it holds.
A decorative container awarded for winning a competition.
To curve your hands into a hollow shape to hold something.

ex.en: I warmed my hands around a cup of tea.
Encouraging customers to bring a reusable cup can help cafés reduce waste from disposable packaging.

col: a cup of tea｜một tách trà
a reusable cup｜cốc dùng nhiều lần
cup your hands｜khum hai bàn tay lại
tip: a cup of đi với đồ uống; cup làm động từ có thể nghĩa là ôm bằng hai tay.

senses.en: a story or events recorded as moving pictures
to record moving pictures using a camera

senses.zh: lớp màng mỏng; phim chụp ảnh
senses.en: a thin layer, or material used to record photographs

ex.en: We watched a funny film after dinner yesterday.
Documentary films can raise public awareness of environmental problems by showing their effects on local communities.

col: film industry｜ngành công nghiệp điện ảnh
a thin film of oil｜một lớp dầu mỏng
tip: Với nghĩa “phim”, film thiên về Anh-Anh còn movie thiên về Anh-Mỹ.

senses.en: the United States of America
North and South America considered together

ex.en: My cousin moved to America to study engineering.
Many universities in America attract international students through their research facilities and diverse academic programmes.

tip: Trong giao tiếp hằng ngày thường chỉ nước Mỹ; gộp cả Bắc và Nam Mỹ thường dùng the Americas.

senses.en: the day after Sunday and before Tuesday

ex.en: We usually buy fresh fruit at the market on Monday.
Many employees find Monday mornings stressful because they must deal with tasks accumulated over the weekend.

col: from Monday to Friday｜từ thứ Hai đến thứ Sáu
tip: Viết hoa tên thứ; dùng on Monday, nhưng trước next Monday không dùng on.

senses.en: a country in northern Europe, with Stockholm as its capital

ex.en: We travelled through Sweden by train last summer.
Sweden is frequently discussed in international debates about public welfare, environmental policy, and the funding of education.

col: travel to Sweden｜du lịch đến Thụy Điển
Sweden's capital｜thủ đô của Thụy Điển
tip: Sweden là Thụy Điển; Switzerland mới là Thụy Sĩ, đừng nhầm hai nước.

senses.en: In addition to or different from someone or something mentioned
Used after or to introduce an alternative or consequence

ex.en: Would you like anything else with your soup?
Governments must improve public transport, or else growing traffic congestion may undermine the economic benefits of urban development.

tip: else đứng sau đại từ bất định hoặc từ để hỏi, ví dụ someone else.

senses.en: A country in southwestern Europe, west of Spain.

ex.en: We travelled along the coast of Portugal by train.
Tourism contributes to the economy of Portugal, but coastal development requires careful planning to protect natural habitats.

col: mainland Portugal｜lục địa Bồ Đào Nha
northern Portugal｜miền bắc Bồ Đào Nha
the coast of Portugal｜bờ biển Bồ Đào Nha
tip: Trước tên nước thường không có the; Portuguese chỉ tiếng Bồ Đào Nha hoặc thuộc về Bồ Đào Nha.

senses.en: Inside a place, container, or larger area.

senses.zh: trong khoảng; sau (một khoảng thời gian)
senses.en: During a period or after a stated amount of time.

senses.zh: ở trong; vào trong; ở nhà
senses.en: Inside a place, moving inside, or at home.

ex.en: Your keys are in the bowl beside the door.
Investment in public libraries can help reduce educational inequality and strengthen connections within local communities.

col: in public｜công khai; ở nơi công cộng
tip: in two days thường nghĩa là “sau hai ngày”; trước tháng và năm cũng dùng in.

senses.en: the highest part or surface of something
highest in position, rank, or quality
to rank highest or be greater than something

ex.en: She placed the star on top of the tree.
Improving access to affordable housing should be a top priority for governments facing rapid urban population growth.

col: at the top of｜ở đỉnh của
top the list｜đứng đầu danh sách
tip: on top of nghĩa là ở phía trên (bề mặt); at the top of nghĩa là ở đỉnh.

senses.en: Having a colour made by mixing red and blue
A colour between red and blue

ex.en: He wore a purple scarf with his grey coat.
Garden designers often combine purple flowers with yellow varieties to create a striking visual contrast.

col: purple flowers｜những bông hoa màu tím
tip: purple có thể là tính từ hoặc danh từ; purplish nghĩa là “hơi tím”.

senses.en: A narrow-necked container for liquids, or the amount it holds.
To put a liquid into bottles for storage or sale.

ex.en: She filled her water bottle before leaving the house.
Choosing a reusable bottle instead of disposable plastic containers can help reduce waste in cities.

col: a bottle of water｜một chai nước
tip: a bottle of water là một chai nước; water bottle là bình/chai đựng nước.

senses.en: The sixth month of the year, between May and July.

ex.en: My sister is getting married in June this year.
The community centre will open in June, providing local residents with affordable exercise classes.

col: by the end of June｜cuối tháng Sáu
tip: Tên tháng viết hoa chữ cái đầu; dùng in June để nói vào tháng Sáu.

senses.en: Move around a centre or change direction.
Change to a different state, colour, or condition.
An opportunity to do something in an agreed order.

ex.en: Turn the handle gently and pull the door towards you.
As populations age, governments must turn their attention to accessible housing and community healthcare.

tip: Khi nghĩa là “trở nên”, turn đi với tính từ; turn into đi với danh từ.

senses.en: a part of something or a single item
a work of writing, music, or art
to join separate parts to make something complete

ex.en: She saved the last piece of cake for her brother.
Each piece of evidence should be carefully assessed before researchers draw conclusions about environmental change.

col: a piece of advice｜một lời khuyên
a piece of equipment｜một thiết bị
a piece of music｜một bản nhạc
tip: a piece of dùng để đếm các danh từ không đếm được như advice.

senses.en: having a pale red colour
a colour made by mixing red with white

ex.en: The tree outside our window has pink flowers.
Designers often use soft colours such as pink to create a welcoming atmosphere in children's healthcare facilities.

tip: pink vừa là tính từ, vừa là danh từ chỉ màu hồng.

senses.en: A period of teaching or learning a particular subject.

senses.zh: bài học kinh nghiệm; điều rút ra
senses.en: Something useful learned from an experience, especially a mistake.

ex.en: Our swimming lesson starts after school on Thursday.
A key lesson from previous environmental policies is that effective regulation requires consistent monitoring and public support.

col: learn a lesson｜rút ra bài học
a valuable lesson｜bài học quý giá
tip: learn a lesson thường nghĩa là rút ra bài học, không chỉ là học một bài trên lớp.

senses.en: an area of land where flowers or vegetables are grown
to grow and care for plants in a garden

ex.en: We picked fresh beans from the garden before lunch.
Community gardens can strengthen neighbourhood relationships while giving urban residents access to fresh vegetables and green space.

tip: Trong Anh-Anh, garden có thể chỉ sân vườn nhà ở; Anh-Mỹ thường dùng yard.

senses.en: the study of Earth's places, environments, and human activity

senses.zh: đặc điểm địa lý; địa hình
senses.en: the physical features and arrangement of a particular area

ex.en: In geography today, we learned how rivers shape valleys.
The geography of coastal regions influences settlement patterns and determines how communities respond to rising sea levels.

tip: geography là địa lý; geology là địa chất, đừng nhầm hai từ.

senses.en: a white substance used to flavour or preserve food
to add salt to food or preserve it with salt

ex.en: Please pass the salt before the soup gets cold.
Reducing salt intake is an effective way to lower the risk of high blood pressure.

col: a pinch of salt｜một nhúm muối
tip: Muối ăn thường không đếm được; “một nhúm muối” dùng a pinch of salt.

senses.en: Up to a particular time or event.
Up to the time when something happens.

ex.en: We waited outside until the rain finally stopped.
Governments should continue supporting renewable energy until cleaner technologies become affordable for the majority of households.

col: until further notice｜cho đến khi có thông báo mới
tip: until nhấn mạnh sự việc kéo dài đến một thời điểm; by nhấn mạnh không muộn hơn thời điểm đó.

senses.en: Every individual member of a group, considered separately.
Every person or thing in a group, taken separately.
For every individual person or thing.

ex.en: Each child carried a small basket into the garden.
Each household can reduce its environmental impact by conserving water and choosing products with less packaging.

col: each of us｜mỗi người trong chúng ta
tip: each đi với danh từ số ít; each of đi với danh từ số nhiều hoặc đại từ.

senses.en: More than one adult female person.

ex.en: Three women were planting flowers in the shared garden.
Equal access to education enables more women to pursue careers in science and technology.

col: women in leadership｜phụ nữ giữ vị trí lãnh đạo
tip: Là số nhiều của woman; âm đầu đọc /wɪ/, không phải /wʊ/.

senses.en: An emotional state or response to something

senses.zh: xúc giác; cảm giác của cơ thể
senses.en: A physical sensation or the ability to sense touch
An impression or belief not necessarily supported by evidence

ex.en: A feeling of relief washed over me after the exam.
A strong feeling of belonging can improve students' confidence and encourage participation in school activities.

col: a feeling of relief｜cảm giác nhẹ nhõm
hurt someone's feelings｜làm tổn thương tình cảm của ai
tip: feelings thường chỉ tình cảm; have a feeling that diễn tả linh cảm.

senses.en: Washing your body while sitting or lying in water.
A large container that you fill with water for washing yourself.

ex.en: A warm bath helped me relax after the hike.
Taking shorter showers instead of a daily bath can reduce household water consumption significantly.

col: run a bath｜xả nước vào bồn tắm
tip: Anh-Anh thường nói have a bath; Anh-Mỹ thường nói take a bath.

senses.en: The number after eight and before ten.

ex.en: We packed nine apples for our picnic today.
The survey found that nine local schools had introduced cycling lessons to encourage more sustainable travel.

col: nine times out of ten｜chín phần mười; hầu như luôn luôn
tip: nine là số đếm; số thứ tự là ninth (chú ý bỏ chữ e).

senses.en: the number after eleven and before thirteen

ex.en: There are twelve fresh eggs in this carton.
The training programme lasts twelve weeks and combines practical experience with classroom instruction for young adults.

tip: twelve là số đếm; số thứ tự twelfth có cách viết thay đổi.

senses.en: A very short period of time.
A particular point in time, sometimes especially important.

ex.en: Wait a moment while I put my shoes on.
The opening of the new railway marked a significant moment in the region's economic development.

col: at the moment｜hiện giờ; lúc này
in a moment｜chút nữa; ngay thôi
a brief moment｜một khoảnh khắc ngắn
a turning point moment｜thời điểm bước ngoặt
tip: at the moment nghĩa là bây giờ; in a moment nghĩa là chốc nữa.

senses.en: To desire something or wish for something to happen.

senses.zh: sự thiếu thốn; sự nghèo túng
senses.en: A lack of something needed, especially basic necessities.

ex.en: I want to grow tomatoes on our balcony.
Many young adults want governments to invest more in affordable housing rather than expensive urban redevelopment projects.

col: want to do something｜muốn làm gì
want someone to do something｜muốn ai làm gì
tip: Dùng want to do hoặc want sb to do; không dùng want doing để diễn tả ý muốn làm gì.

senses.zh: nước Anh (Anh quốc thuộc Vương quốc Anh)
senses.en: A country forming part of the United Kingdom.

ex.en: My cousin lives in a quiet village in England.
Historic towns in England attract international visitors, creating jobs while increasing pressure on local infrastructure.

col: the north of England｜miền bắc nước Anh
travel to England｜du lịch đến nước Anh
tip: England chỉ riêng xứ England, không đồng nghĩa với toàn bộ Vương quốc Anh (the UK).

senses.en: To have an opinion or belief about something.
To use your mind to consider ideas or solve problems.

ex.en: I think this soup needs a little more salt.
Some people think that schools should devote more time to practical skills rather than examination preparation.

tip: Quá khứ và quá khứ phân từ đều là thought; với nghĩa “cho rằng” thường không dùng thì tiếp diễn.

senses.en: one more, or a different one

senses.zh: một cái khác; một người nữa
senses.en: one more person or thing, or a different one

ex.en: This cup is cracked, so please bring me another.
Another reason to invest in public transport is its potential to reduce urban air pollution.

col: one after another｜cái này đến cái khác
another two days｜thêm hai ngày nữa
tip: Thường đi với danh từ số ít; another two days nghĩa là thêm hai ngày nữa.

senses.en: a structure with walls and a roof
the activity of constructing houses or other structures

ex.en: Our apartment building has a garden on the roof.
Improving insulation in older buildings can reduce energy consumption and lower heating costs for residents.

tip: Khi chỉ tòa nhà thì đếm được; khi chỉ hoạt động xây dựng thì thường không đếm được.

senses.en: having plenty of bright sunlight
cheerful and positive in character or mood

ex.en: We ate breakfast on the sunny balcony this morning.
Regions with sunny climates can generate substantial amounts of electricity through well-planned solar energy projects.

tip: sunny nhấn mạnh có nhiều nắng, không nhất thiết là trời nóng.

senses.en: To move through water using your body.
An occasion when you move through water for exercise or pleasure.

ex.en: We swim in the indoor pool every Saturday morning.
Schools should teach children to swim because this essential skill improves both physical fitness and water safety.

tip: Động từ bất quy tắc: swim - swam - swum.

senses.zh: khoa học; khoa học tự nhiên
senses.en: Study of the natural world through observation and experiments

senses.zh: môn khoa học; ngành khoa học
senses.en: A particular field of study using scientific methods

ex.en: We grew tiny crystals in our science class today.
Investment in science can help countries develop cleaner energy sources and improve public health.

col: advances in science｜những tiến bộ khoa học
tip: Khoa học nói chung thường không đếm được; khi chỉ một ngành cụ thể có thể dùng a science.

senses.en: Soft white frozen flakes falling from clouds or covering the ground.
For snow to fall from the sky.

ex.en: Fresh snow covered the garden when we woke up.
Heavy snow can disrupt public transport and prevent rural communities from accessing essential services.

tip: snow là danh từ thường không đếm được; nói “trời có tuyết” dùng it snows.

senses.en: to fail to remember a fact, person, or experience
to fail to do or bring something through not remembering

ex.en: I always forget where I put my reading glasses.
Students may quickly forget new vocabulary unless they review it regularly and use it in meaningful contexts.

col: forget to do something｜quên làm gì
forget about｜quên đi; không nghĩ đến nữa
tip: forget to do là quên (chưa) làm; forget doing là quên là đã làm.

senses.en: At a low speed or over a long time.

ex.en: She slowly poured the hot soup into bowls.
Although public attitudes are changing slowly, more consumers are choosing products with less plastic packaging.

tip: slowly là trạng từ, bổ nghĩa cho hành động; slow thường là tính từ.

senses.zh: căn hộ; căn hộ trong tòa nhà
senses.en: a set of rooms forming a home within a building
level and smooth, without raised or curved parts
having too little air inside, especially a tyre

ex.en: We rent a small flat above a busy bakery.
Building affordable flats near public transport could reduce commuting costs for many urban workers.

tip: Căn hộ trong Anh-Anh thường là flat, trong Anh-Mỹ thường là apartment.

senses.en: Two lenses in a frame worn to improve sight.

senses.zh: những chiếc ly thủy tinh (số nhiều)
senses.en: Containers made of glass, usually used for drinking.

ex.en: I left my glasses beside the bed last night.
Regular eye examinations help students obtain suitable glasses, allowing them to read comfortably and participate fully in lessons.

col: a pair of glasses｜một cặp kính
reading glasses｜kính đọc sách; kính lão
tip: Với nghĩa kính mắt luôn dùng số nhiều; “một chiếc kính” nói là a pair of glasses.

senses.en: Different from usual, often in an important or valued way.
Intended for a particular purpose or person.

senses.zh: món đặc biệt; hàng giảm giá
senses.en: A specially priced product or a featured restaurant dish.

ex.en: We saved this special cake for your birthday.
Schools should provide special equipment so that students with disabilities can participate fully in classroom activities.

col: special attention｜sự chú ý đặc biệt
tip: specially nhấn mạnh làm riêng cho mục đích; especially thường nghĩa là “đặc biệt là”.

senses.en: a living thing that usually grows in soil and has leaves
to put seeds or young plants into soil to grow

senses.zh: nhà máy; cơ sở công nghiệp
senses.en: a factory or facility where industrial processes take place

ex.en: This little plant needs more sunlight and less water.
Local authorities should plant more trees to improve air quality and provide shade in crowded neighbourhoods.

tip: plant có thể là thực vật hoặc nhà máy; khi là động từ thường nghĩa là trồng.

senses.en: The flesh of animals eaten as food.

ex.en: We keep raw meat separate from vegetables in the fridge.
Reducing meat consumption may lower the environmental impact of food production in many countries.

tip: Khi chỉ thịt nói chung thì không đếm được; meats chỉ các loại thịt khác nhau.

senses.en: The activity of moving through water using your body.

ex.en: We go swimming at the indoor pool every Saturday.
Regular swimming can improve physical fitness while placing relatively little stress on the joints.

tip: Khi chỉ môn thể thao thì không đếm được; “đi bơi” dùng go swimming.

senses.en: A low plant with narrow green leaves covering the ground.

ex.en: We spread a blanket on the grass beside the river.
Replacing natural grass with artificial surfaces can reduce habitats for insects and increase local temperatures.

col: a blade of grass｜một lá cỏ
tip: Thường không đếm được; “một lá cỏ” dùng a blade of grass.

senses.en: Help someone learn knowledge, skills, or ways of behaving

ex.en: My aunt taught me how to mend a shirt.
Schools should teach children how to evaluate online information rather than simply memorise facts.

col: teach a subject｜dạy một môn học
teach someone to swim｜dạy ai bơi
teach a lesson｜dạy một bài học; cho ai một bài học
tip: Quá khứ và quá khứ phân từ đều là taught; dạy ai làm gì dùng teach sb to do.

senses.en: a country in central Europe known for the Alps

ex.en: We travelled through Switzerland by train during our holiday.
Switzerland demonstrates how reliable rail networks can support tourism while reducing dependence on private cars.

col: travel to Switzerland｜du lịch đến Thụy Sĩ
tip: Switzerland là Thụy Sĩ, Sweden là Thụy Điển; tính từ “thuộc Thụy Sĩ” là Swiss.

senses.en: Hold or support something while moving it somewhere
Have something with you wherever you go
Contain and potentially pass on a disease or infection

ex.en: Could you carry this heavy bag upstairs for me?
Reusable bottles allow commuters to carry drinking water without purchasing disposable plastic containers every day.

col: carry out research｜tiến hành nghiên cứu
tip: carry nhấn mạnh việc mang/vác; bring và take còn thể hiện hướng di chuyển.

senses.en: Thin strands growing on the skin of people and animals.

senses.zh: một sợi tóc; một sợi lông
senses.en: A single strand growing from skin.

ex.en: She tied her hair back before making lunch.
Some workplaces are relaxing rules about hair and clothing to create a more inclusive environment.

col: have your hair cut｜đi cắt tóc
a strand of hair｜một lọn tóc
tip: Tóc nói chung không đếm được; một sợi tóc dùng a hair.

senses.en: Having the colour of grass and most leaves.
Causing little harm to the environment.
The colour of grass and most leaves.

ex.en: She wore a green jacket to match her shoes.
Governments can encourage green transport by improving public services and building safer routes for cyclists.

col: go green｜chuyển sang lối sống thân thiện với môi trường
tip: Ngoài chỉ màu, green còn nghĩa thân thiện với môi trường; nói về người còn có thể nghĩa là thiếu kinh nghiệm.

senses.en: To telephone someone or shout to get their attention.
To give someone or something a particular name.
A telephone conversation or a public request for action.

ex.en: I'll call you when I get home tonight.
Environmental groups call for stricter regulations to reduce plastic waste entering rivers and oceans.

col: call for action｜kêu gọi hành động
call someone back｜gọi lại cho ai
tip: call sb nghĩa là gọi điện cho ai, không thêm to.

senses.en: A food made by pressing or ripening the solids of milk.

ex.en: I added some cheese to my warm vegetable sandwich.
Although cheese provides protein and calcium, some varieties contain high levels of salt and saturated fat.

col: a slice of cheese｜một lát phô mai
cheese sandwich｜bánh mì kẹp phô mai
tip: Thường không đếm được; một miếng phô mai dùng a piece of cheese.

senses.en: Extending a great distance or lasting a great time.
For a great amount of time.
To want something very strongly, especially something unavailable.

ex.en: Her long scarf nearly touched the wet pavement.
Long commuting times can reduce workers' leisure opportunities and negatively affect their overall quality of life.

col: a long time｜một thời gian dài
long to do something｜khao khát làm gì
tip: Động từ long đi với for + danh từ, hoặc to + động từ nguyên mẫu.

senses.en: an occasion when people gather to discuss something
an occasion when people come together, by arrangement or chance

ex.en: Our team meeting starts right after lunch today.
Regular meetings between teachers and parents can help identify learning difficulties at an early stage.

col: hold a meeting｜tổ chức cuộc họp
attend a meeting｜tham dự cuộc họp
arrange a meeting｜sắp xếp cuộc gặp
tip: Tham dự cuộc họp dùng attend a meeting; meeting cũng có thể chỉ một cuộc gặp gỡ.

senses.zh: người phục vụ bàn; bồi bàn nam
senses.en: A person, traditionally male, who serves food in a restaurant

ex.en: The waiter brought our soup and two warm rolls.
A well-trained waiter can improve the dining experience by responding patiently to customers with different needs.

col: work as a waiter｜làm bồi bàn
ask the waiter｜hỏi người phục vụ
tip: waiter theo truyền thống chỉ nam phục vụ; server ít nhấn mạnh giới tính hơn.

senses.en: an organisation that holds money and provides financial services
land along the edge of a river or lake
put money into an account at a bank

ex.en: I went to the bank to open an account.
Banks can support local economic development by offering affordable loans to small businesses and new entrepreneurs.

tip: Ở bờ sông dùng on the bank; ở ngân hàng dùng at hoặc in the bank.

senses.en: a room where students are taught

ex.en: Sunlight filled the classroom as we opened our books.
A well-designed classroom should provide adequate lighting, comfortable furniture, and enough space for students to work together.

tip: in the classroom nhấn mạnh ở trong phòng học; in class nhấn mạnh đang trong giờ học.

senses.en: An arrangement or idea for what to do in future.
To decide what to do and how to do it.
A drawing showing the layout of a building or area.

ex.en: Our plan is to leave early and avoid traffic.
Cities need a clear plan for expanding public transport before introducing restrictions on private vehicles.

col: plan to do something｜dự định làm gì
floor plan｜sơ đồ mặt bằng tầng
tip: plan to do nghĩa là dự định làm gì; quá khứ planned gấp đôi chữ n.

senses.en: making you laugh or smile
unusual or difficult to explain

ex.en: That funny story made everyone at the table laugh.
Teachers sometimes use funny examples to make difficult concepts more memorable and encourage students to participate.

col: a funny story｜một câu chuyện buồn cười
a funny joke｜một câu chuyện cười
find something funny｜thấy điều gì đó buồn cười
tip: funny thiên về buồn cười hoặc kỳ lạ; fun thiên về vui vẻ, thú vị.

senses.en: To give money for something or for someone's work
Money received regularly for doing a job
To bring a benefit or be worth doing

ex.en: Can I pay for these apples by card?
Employers should pay workers fairly to improve staff morale and reduce the number of people leaving.

col: pay a bill｜thanh toán hóa đơn
pay for something｜trả tiền cho cái gì
tip: pay for đi với món hàng được mua; pay đi với hóa đơn hoặc số tiền; quá khứ là paid.

senses.en: Having lived or existed for a long time.
Having a particular age.
Belonging to an earlier period of someone's life.

ex.en: Our old dog sleeps beside the warm kitchen stove.
Preserving old buildings can protect cultural heritage while attracting visitors and supporting the local economy.

tip: an old friend thường là người bạn quen biết lâu năm, chưa chắc đã lớn tuổi.

senses.en: A country in southern Europe whose capital is Rome.

ex.en: We travelled around Italy by train last summer.
Italy attracts international visitors through its historic cities, distinctive cuisine, and rich artistic heritage.

col: travel to Italy｜du lịch đến Ý
made in Italy｜sản xuất tại Ý
tip: Tên quốc gia viết hoa chữ cái đầu, thường không có the; Italian chỉ tiếng Ý, người Ý hoặc thuộc về nước Ý.

senses.en: Something incorrect that you do, say, or believe.
To wrongly identify someone or understand something incorrectly.

ex.en: I took your umbrella by mistake this morning.
Teachers should encourage students to learn from mistakes rather than feel ashamed of making them.

col: by mistake｜do nhầm lẫn; vô tình
learn from mistakes｜học từ những sai lầm
mistake A for B｜nhầm A với B
tip: Nói make a mistake, không nói do a mistake; quá khứ của động từ là mistook.

senses.zh: lặp lại; nhắc lại; làm lại
senses.en: To say or do something again.

senses.zh: sự lặp lại; sự tái diễn; chương trình phát lại
senses.en: Something that happens or is shown again.

ex.en: Could you repeat the address a little more slowly?
Students who repeat new vocabulary aloud regularly may develop greater confidence when speaking a foreign language.

col: repeat a mistake｜lặp lại sai lầm
repeat a question｜lặp lại câu hỏi
repeat after someone｜nhắc lại theo ai
a repeat performance｜buổi biểu diễn lặp lại
tip: repeat đã có nghĩa “lần nữa” nên thường không cần thêm again.

senses.zh: chào đón; vui vẻ đón nhận
senses.en: to greet someone warmly or accept something with pleasure
wanted, appreciated, or gladly accepted

senses.zh: sự chào đón; sự tiếp đón
senses.en: the way someone is greeted when they arrive

ex.en: Our neighbours came outside to welcome us home.
Many communities welcome new cultural festivals because they encourage social interaction and support local businesses.

col: a warm welcome｜sự chào đón nồng nhiệt
a welcome change｜một thay đổi đáng mừng
you're welcome｜không có gì (đáp lời cảm ơn)
tip: be welcome to do nghĩa là cứ tự nhiên làm; You're welcome dùng để đáp lời cảm ơn.

senses.en: a soft red fruit with tiny seeds on its surface

ex.en: I picked a ripe strawberry and put it in my basket.
Growing strawberries locally can reduce transport distances, although heated greenhouses may increase overall energy consumption.

tip: Danh từ đếm được, số nhiều là strawberries.

senses.en: the number after fifteen and before seventeen

ex.en: We baked sixteen small cakes for the family picnic.
In some countries, students can choose vocational training instead of continuing general education at the age of sixteen.

tip: Chú ý phân biệt với sixty (sáu mươi): sixteen có trọng âm ở cuối, đọc rõ âm /n/.

senses.en: a period of seven days
the days or hours normally spent working each week

ex.en: I borrowed this book from the library last week.
A shorter working week could improve employee wellbeing, provided that workloads are reduced rather than compressed.

col: once a week｜mỗi tuần một lần
tip: Trước last/next/this week không dùng giới từ.

senses.en: The number after sixteen and before eighteen.

ex.en: My sister is seventeen and loves playing volleyball.
The survey found that seventeen students preferred practical training to traditional classroom instruction.

tip: Chú ý phân biệt với seventy (bảy mươi): seventeen có trọng âm ở cuối, đọc rõ âm cuối.

senses.en: the day after Tuesday and before Thursday

ex.en: We meet for lunch every Wednesday near the library.
The community centre offers free language classes every Wednesday to help newcomers participate in local life.

tip: Viết hoa chữ cái đầu; dùng on Wednesday, nhưng trước every Wednesday không dùng on.

senses.zh: sáng (từ nửa đêm đến trước buổi trưa)
senses.en: During the time from midnight until just before midday.

ex.en: My alarm rings at seven a.m. every weekday.
Starting school before eight a.m. may reduce the amount of sleep that teenagers get on weekdays.

col: at six a.m.｜lúc sáu giờ sáng
from nine a.m.｜từ chín giờ sáng
until eleven a.m.｜cho đến mười một giờ sáng
tip: Đặt sau giờ; 12 a.m. là nửa đêm, 12 p.m. là giữa trưa.

senses.en: Recently made, discovered, introduced, or begun.
Recently obtained or experienced by someone, though possibly already existing.
Not yet familiar with a place, activity, or situation.

ex.en: Our new neighbours brought us a basket of apples.
New technologies can make healthcare more accessible, but their benefits must be shared across different income groups.

col: new to the job｜mới làm công việc
a new approach｜một cách tiếp cận mới
tip: be new to nghĩa là mới làm quen, chưa thạo; ở đây to là giới từ.

senses.en: The activity of preparing food by heating it.
Intended for use in preparing food.

ex.en: My brother does the cooking while I wash dishes.
Teaching basic cooking skills at school can help young people develop healthier eating habits.

col: home cooking｜nấu ăn kiểu gia đình
tip: cooking chỉ việc nấu nướng; cook có thể là đầu bếp, cooker là dụng cụ nấu.

senses.en: a group of people related to one another
a group of related animals, plants, languages, or other things

ex.en: My family gathers around the kitchen table every Sunday.
Flexible working hours can help parents balance family responsibilities with the demands of paid employment.

tip: family coi như một khối thì dùng số ít; trong Anh-Anh khi nhấn mạnh các thành viên có thể dùng với động từ số nhiều.

senses.en: Something specific that shows what a general idea means
A person or action that others can learn from or copy

ex.en: Could you give me an example of a healthy breakfast?
Public buildings can set an example by using renewable energy and reducing unnecessary water consumption.

col: give an example｜đưa ra ví dụ
a typical example｜một ví dụ điển hình
tip: for example dùng để nêu ví dụ; set an example nghĩa là làm gương.

senses.en: the final month of the year, following November

ex.en: My cousin is coming to stay with us in December.
In many northern countries, energy demand increases in December as households need more heating during colder weather.

tip: Tên tháng viết hoa chữ cái đầu; dùng in December để nói vào tháng Mười Hai.

senses.en: A unit of length equal to one hundred centimetres.
A regular pattern of stressed and unstressed syllables in poetry.

ex.en: This shelf is just over a metre long.
Raising coastal barriers by one metre could help protect nearby homes from increasingly severe flooding.

tip: Đơn vị đo độ dài Anh-Anh viết metre, Anh-Mỹ viết meter; số nhiều là metres.

senses.en: To dislike someone or something very strongly.

senses.zh: lòng căm ghét; sự ghét cay ghét đắng
senses.en: A very strong feeling of dislike towards someone or something.

ex.en: I hate finding wet socks on the bathroom floor.
Although many commuters hate crowded trains, affordable public transport remains essential for reducing urban traffic.

col: hate to admit｜không muốn thừa nhận
tip: hate có thể theo sau là danh động từ hoặc động từ nguyên mẫu, mạnh nghĩa hơn dislike.

senses.en: to rest with eyes closed and awareness reduced
the natural resting state in which awareness is reduced

ex.en: Our cat likes to sleep beside the warm radiator.
Regular sleep supports memory and concentration, making it particularly important for students preparing for examinations.

tip: Quá khứ và quá khứ phân từ đều là slept; “chìm vào giấc ngủ” dùng fall asleep.

senses.en: A small brush used for cleaning your teeth.

ex.en: I packed my toothbrush in the side pocket.
Replacing a worn toothbrush regularly helps maintain oral hygiene by ensuring that teeth are cleaned effectively.

col: electric toothbrush｜bàn chải đánh răng điện
soft toothbrush｜bàn chải đánh răng lông mềm
toothbrush holder｜giá để bàn chải đánh răng
tip: Số nhiều là toothbrushes, không phải teethbrushes.

senses.en: a piece of furniture with a flat top and legs
information arranged in rows and columns

ex.en: We gathered around the table to share fresh bread.
The table compares average household spending on transport in three cities over a ten-year period.

col: set the table｜dọn bàn ăn (bày bát đĩa)
a table of results｜bảng kết quả
tip: set the table nghĩa là bày bát đĩa, dao dĩa lên bàn, không phải kê cái bàn.

senses.en: To become a member or take part with others.
To connect things or become connected.

senses.zh: cùng tham gia với (ai); cùng làm
senses.en: To go where someone is and spend time with them.

ex.en: Would you like to join us for lunch today?
Students who join local volunteer groups can develop practical skills while contributing to their communities.

col: join a club｜gia nhập câu lạc bộ
tip: join a club nghĩa là gia nhập tổ chức; join in nghĩa là cùng tham gia hoạt động.

senses.en: Helping you do something or achieve a purpose

ex.en: This little torch is useful when the power fails.
Reliable online resources can be useful for learners who lack access to well-equipped libraries.

col: useful for learning｜hữu ích cho việc học
a useful tool｜một công cụ hữu ích
tip: Âm đầu là phụ âm /j/ nên nói a useful tool, không dùng an.

senses.en: to enjoy something or feel positively about someone
similar to someone or something

senses.zh: ví dụ như; chẳng hạn như
senses.en: used to introduce an example

ex.en: I like reading by the window on rainy afternoons.
Many residents like having green spaces nearby because they provide opportunities for exercise and relaxation.

col: feel like doing something｜cảm thấy muốn làm gì
tip: would like to do lịch sự hơn want to do.

senses.en: A short written message or record of useful information.
To notice something or record it in writing.
A single musical sound or a symbol representing it.

ex.en: I left a note beside your breakfast bowl.
Students who take notes in their own words may develop a deeper understanding of complex material.

col: leave a note｜để lại lời nhắn
tip: Ghi chép dùng take notes; note that theo sau là một mệnh đề đầy đủ.

senses.en: To move downward, lose balance, or decrease.
An act of falling or a decrease in amount.
The season between summer and winter, especially in American English.

ex.en: Golden leaves fall onto the path outside our house.
Energy consumption may fall if governments encourage households to install better insulation and efficient heating systems.

tip: Quá khứ fell, quá khứ phân từ fallen; mùa thu trong Anh-Anh thường dùng autumn.

senses.en: The number equal to three groups of ten.

ex.en: The soup needs another thirty minutes on the stove.
The survey found that thirty per cent of residents preferred cycling to driving for short journeys.

col: thirty per cent｜ba mươi phần trăm
in your thirties｜ở độ tuổi ba mươi
tip: thirty có trọng âm ở âm tiết đầu; thirteen thường có trọng âm ở âm tiết sau.

senses.en: Better than all others in quality or suitability.
In the most successful way or to the greatest degree.

senses.zh: điều tốt nhất; phần tốt nhất
senses.en: The finest performance, effort, or thing available.

ex.en: This bakery makes the best bread in our neighbourhood.
Investing in early education may be the best way to reduce inequality over time.

col: the best option｜lựa chọn tốt nhất
do your best｜cố gắng hết sức
at its best｜ở trạng thái tốt nhất
like something best｜thích cái gì nhất
tip: best là dạng so sánh nhất của good và well; trước tính từ thường có the.

senses.en: Some in questions or negatives; whichever one, without restriction.
Some or whichever ones, without naming the people or things.
At all, used mainly with comparisons in questions or negatives.

ex.en: You can borrow any book from this shelf.
Governments should ensure that all children can attend school without facing any financial barriers.

col: any questions｜bất kỳ câu hỏi nào
at any time｜bất cứ lúc nào
any of these｜bất kỳ cái nào trong số này
tip: Trong câu hỏi và phủ định any thường nghĩa “một ít”; trong câu khẳng định thường nghĩa “bất kỳ”.
